description: Charts drawn with Apache ECharts — bar, line, pie (donut, rose), scatter, histogram, box plot, candlestick, heatmap, funnel, gauge and radar plots, combined bar-and-line charts with a second axis, linear, log, category and time axes. Data is written inline or as a table with named columns that several charts share, and a collection of charts is shown as tabs. Successor to L0173.

example_prompts.prompt: Bar chart of monthly revenue for January to April: 120, 132, 101, 134.
example_prompts.notes: One chart in the collection: `charts [ chart [ axes [ axis direction X categories ["Jan" …] {} axis direction Y {} ] {} plots [ plot kind BAR values [120 132 101 134] {} ] {} ] {} ] {}`.

example_prompts.prompt: Revenue as bars and margin % as a line on its own axis, for four quarters.
example_prompts.notes: Two Y axes with ids, and each plot names its axis with `y-axis "…"`.

example_prompts.prompt: A donut of traffic sources with percentages on the slices.
example_prompts.notes: `plot kind PIE names […] values […] inner-radius "50%" label formatter "{b}: {d}%" {} {}`.

example_prompts.prompt: From this table of months, revenue and cost, show a trend chart and a cost breakdown as two tabs.
example_prompts.notes: One shared `datasets` in the outer list; two charts whose plots name columns (`values "revenue"`).

example_prompts.prompt: Box plot of quiz scores by class: A 72, 75, 78, 80, 84, 91; B 60, 68, 70, 74, 77, 99.
example_prompts.notes: Raw observations, grouped: `plot kind BOXPLOT values [[72 75 78 80 84 91] [60 68 70 74 77 99]] {}` with `categories ["A" "B"]` on the X axis. Quartiles and outliers are computed.

example_prompts.prompt: Radar chart comparing two cars on speed, power, range and cost.
example_prompts.notes: One `axis direction RADIAL categories ["Speed" "Power" "Range" "Cost"] {}` and a `plot kind RADAR values […] {}` per car.

example_prompts.prompt: Chart the data at this URL.
example_prompts.notes: Not supported: L0184 plots only data given in the request.
